perfume.answer: Ethiopian Airlines allows aerosols such as hair spray, perfume and medicines containing alcohol in both carry-on and checked baggage, up to 0.5 kg/L per article and 2.0 kg/L in total.

sections.h: 🧴 What Ethiopian Airlines says about perfume and aerosols
sections.p: From the Ethiopian Airlines Restricted Items page (US site), read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
Ethiopian Airlines rule
rows: Aerosols: hair sprays, perfumes and medicines containing alcohol
Not more than 0.5 kg or 0.5 L
Not more than 2.0 kg or 2.0 L in total weight

list: Not on the page: the table does not mention the 100 ml cabin container limit or valve caps.

faq: How much perfume can I take on Ethiopian Airlines?
Not more than 0.5 kg or 0.5 L per article and 2.0 kg or 2.0 L in total, in carry-on or checked baggage.
Can I carry hair spray in hand baggage on Ethiopian Airlines?
Yes, the Restricted Items table lists hair sprays and perfumes as allowed in carry-on and check-in within the same limits.
